about: Open Decimal512/Int512 defects of the Sentio fork, as exposed by the checks in tests/. scripts/check_gate.py reads this file: a failing check that matches an OPEN defect is reported as known-open (quick/full exit 3, release BLOCKED), any other failing check is unexpected (exit 1). An open defect whose checks all pass is stale and fails the gate: mark it fixed with evidence in the same change. Expectations encode the intended semantics; they are never edited to make a binary pass. Entries with status `fixed` stay as regression guards: their checks must pass (a failure is unexpected), and a release needs a PROVEN regression proof (recomputed by the gate: the baseline fails, the candidate passes) for every `fixed` entry that names a `proof`.

defects.title: Nullable fixed keys packed into 33-64 bytes: GROUP BY merges NULL with 0; DISTINCT, IN with transform_null_in=1 and JOIN with NULL in a 32-byte column abort (libc++ hardening assertion). Production build a394e92fb5d
defects.fixed_by: bae5ba481f3 (26.3 hotfix candidate branch claude/26.3-lts-decimal512-keysnullmap-512-20260924; not deployed)

defects.title: midpoint/avg2 with a Decimal512 result type (Decimal512 mixed with integers or other decimals): exceptions or garbage values. Production build a394e92fb5d
defects.fixed_by: cd0d6088c5a (26.3 hotfix candidate branch; not deployed)

defects.title: Decimal512 allows precision 154 but Int512 holds only |v| < 2^511 (~6.7e153): out-of-range literals/casts wrap silently. Fork-specific: upstream Decimal256 (precision 76) always fits Int256 (~5.8e76)
defects.decision: user: reject values outside the Int512 range on parse/cast (keep precision 154), or cap the precision at 153 (changes the type, needs a migration plan)

defects.title: Decimal512 multiply does not detect overflow (decimal_check_overflow=1) and wraps silently; plus/minus at the Int512 limit are detected. Inherited: upstream documents that overflow checks are not implemented for Decimal128/Decimal256 (docs/en/sql-reference/data-types/decimal.md:70-72) and official 26.8.8.8 wraps the same way
defects.effect: silent wrong result (upstream-documented limitation for wide decimals)
defects.decision: user: implement an overflow-checked 512-bit multiply (the expectation used here, as Decimal32/Decimal64 behave), or accept the upstream limitation for Decimal512 in writing; the checks keep failing either way until implemented, so an accepted limitation is an explicit release decision, never a pass
defects.evidence: evidence/phase6/matrix_r4 (ops, category boundary, op multiply); official 26.8.8.8: toDecimal128/256 multiply wraps, toDecimal32/64 multiply -> DECIMAL_OVERFLOW (2026-09-24)

defects.title: A single (U)Int512 key (non-nullable, or nullable with its null map stripped) in IN / DISTINCT / JOIN throws LOGICAL_ERROR 'Numeric column has sizeOfField not in 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32'
defects.effect: query error (LOGICAL_ERROR; aborts builds that abort on logical errors, e.g. Debug)
defects.decision: none needed for the expectation (same result as Int256/Decimal512(0)); fix: let SetVariants/HashJoin choose a method for 64-byte numeric keys

defects.title: (U)Int512 integer arithmetic (+ - * intDiv modulo) is not implemented: ILLEGAL_TYPE_OF_ARGUMENT
defects.decision: user: implement with (U)Int256 semantics (the expectation used here), or declare (U)Int512 arithmetic unsupported (then the expectation becomes an explicit error and this entry is closed by a documented decision)

defects.title: The common supertype of (U)Int512 and another integer is Variant(...) instead of (U)Int512 (getLeastSupertype ladder stops at 256); greatest/least throw
defects.effect: silent type change (Variant result), query errors downstream
defects.decision: user: extend the ladder to 512 (the expectation used here) or keep the current behaviour and document it

defects.title: avg2/midpoint of two (U)Int512 throw LOGICAL_ERROR 'Arguments of midpoint have incorrect data types' (same root cause as KD-I512-ARITH)
defects.decision: follows KD-I512-ARITH; expectation = (U)Int256 semantics (truncation toward zero, no overflow)

defects.title: fork test 01875_ssd_cache_dictionary_decimal512_type hard-codes /workspace/.clickhouse_runtime/user_files: PATH_ACCESS_DENIED outside that layout
defects.effect: test defect (coverage missing, not a product result)
defects.decision: fix the test to use the runner's user_files path; do not delete it

defects.title: fork test 02483_capnp_decimals copies its schema to the hard-coded /workspace/.clickhouse_runtime/format_schemas (writes outside the test tree) and fails elsewhere
defects.effect: test defect (coverage missing; side effect on the host)
defects.decision: fix the test to use the runner's format_schemas path; do not delete it

defects.title: fork test blockchain_decimal512_arithmetic_operations: reference differs by 1 ulp in exp(toDecimal512('1', 0)) (same output on buggy and fixed builds)
defects.decision: compare with a tolerance or round the Float64 result in the test; do not re-record the reference from one binary

defects.title: fork test 01875_ssd_cache_dictionary_decimal256_type is disabled: the script prints its reference and exits 0, so its OK runs no query
defects.decision: re-enable after fixing the path issue, or remove it from the selection with a recorded reason
